description: Ask the shop for a quote. Creates a request the shop answers by phone or text; returns a reference and status "requested". The shop confirms estimates directly.

contact_name.description: Name of the person the shop should call

phone.description: Phone number the shop may call or text, digits with optional +, spaces, dashes

symptoms.description: What the car is doing, in the customer's words

vehicle.description: The vehicle the request is about. Optional for a quote, required for a booking.

name: request_quote
